description: This file defines multiple device configurations and target device entries for a Linux-based embedded system build system, likely OpenWrt. It specifies device-specific variables, including vendor, model, device tree source, packages, images, and various options pertinent to building firmware images for different hardware devices.

methods.name: pad-offset
methods.description: Adjusts the kernel or image size by padding with specified offset and size

methods.name: iptime-crc32
methods.description: Calculates or appends CRC32 checksum for ipTIME device images

methods.name: append-metadata
methods.description: Append metadata to images for device identification or other purposes

methods.name: append-kernel
methods.description: Prepends or appends kernel image content to the build artifact

methods.name: pad-to
methods.description: Pads the image up to a specified size

methods.name: append-ubi
methods.description: Appends UBI filesystem image to the firmware

methods.name: check-size
methods.description: Checks if the image size is within allowed limits

methods.name: netgear-encrypted-factory
methods.description: Applies encryption or specific processing for Netgear factory images
